comparison.objective: Transfer a baked wafer with tweezers into a carrier and lock it counterclockwise; unlike tuning a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Tweezers acquisition, fragile wafer transfer, carrier placement, and twist-lock closure versus hex-key engagement, counterholding, fine collar tuning, and setscrew torque.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer must be moved from hotplate, placed pattern-side up, and carrier locked counterclockwise. Placement tolerance, thermal handling, damage, and lock-torque thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Twist locking is only a generic shared primitive; fragile wafer transfer and carrier closure do not test iterative impact-response adjustment.
